text:
maria: Heads-up — we've been seeing a small spike of persistent OTLP gRPC exporter failures from prod today, looks like connection resets + long retries piling up.
kevin: I saw that. Traces backlog on the sidecar queues went from 1k -> 40k in ~10m.
maria: stack traces show dead connections: `EOF` and `transport: http2ClientConn.reset` typically after 2min idle.
arne: Are we using the default backoff? envs show OTEL exporter uses gRPC default retry/backoff; no circuit breaker.
lisa: Can we change default quick? Prod is sensitive to bursts from canaries.
maria: Proposal: set per-exporter circuit-breaker with max_outstanding_per_conn, min_backoff 200ms, max_backoff 20s, add jitter and use shorter RPC timeout 6s.
kevin: Also recommend keepalive ping to avoid idle TCP resets + increase conn pool to 2 per host. gRPC keepalive: `keepalive_time_ms=60000`
maria: sample config I tried locally:
```yaml
exporters:
  otlp:
    protocol: grpc
    endpoint: otlp.collector.internal:4317
    tls: true
    headers: { "x-tenant-id": "redwood-prod" }
    retry_on_failure:
      enabled: true
      initial_interval: 200ms
      max_interval: 20s
      multiplier: 1.3
      max_elapsed_time: 0 # keep retrying per policy
    timeout: 6s
    connection_pool: 2
    keepalive:
      time: 60s
      timeout: 10s
circuit_breakers:
  otlp_exporter:
    max_consecutive_failures: 5
    min_backoff: 200ms
    max_backoff: 20s
    jitter: 0.2
```
arne: Nice. Two caveats: 1) Collector needs to tolerate hedged duplicate traces if we do client-side hedging. 2) Per-tenant quotas should still apply.
lisa: How about HTTP fallback when gRPC fails? We've used http fallback in other services.
kevin: Agree — add protocol fallback: try grpc, on persistent failure switch to http/1.1 with streaming disabled for safety.
maria: I'd also like health probe to gate the circuit-breaker: if exporter fails >= N times mark unhealthy and route to fallback for 60s.
arne: Can we get an A/B on these changes behind a feature flag and metric to track delivery success + latency?
lisa: Yes — rollout plan: canary 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with rollback on >1.5x failed export rate.
kevin: I'll open a PR with the config and a small test harness to simulate TCP resets.
telemetry-bot: Synthetic check: otlp exporter probe failed 2023-11-03T12:07:23Z; reason=stream-reset
maria: Thanks — assign to kevin. I'll add docs to eng-platform runbook about these settings.
kevin: cool. I'll send PR link here when ready. :thumbsup:
